title: Serialize cold-start skill and memory reads
failure_signature: A parallel cold-start batch of local skill, routing, discovery, and memory reads exceeded the ten-second shell startup budget before any content returned.
candidate_workaround: Run the mandatory skill and reference reads serially with a thirty-second bounded timeout, then perform memory discovery separately.
recurrence_guard: At phase startup, serialize required skill reads and allow at least thirty seconds for each cold PowerShell process.
rollback: Stop after the timed-out read; no repository or route state needs rollback because the failed batch was read-only.
protected_gates: No repository mutation before required guidance is read
No task creation or sibling contact
scope_boundary: This method addresses local shell startup latency only and proves no scientific, authority, production, security, accessibility, identity, or reproduction claim.
